verdict.rationale: Deel's MCP/API exposes payroll data (alongside contracts, people, time) to agents and lists tools like listOfContracts and calculateEorVersusEntityHiringCosts, so an agent could in principle pull payroll data for review, but there is no documented payroll-run preview endpoint, anomaly-detection tool, or approval-gate workflow. missing for 10: a specific 'preview payroll run' API/tool, anomaly-flagging capability, and an approval step before committing the run.
